claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters is on Sunday, April 12.
On the Range coverage for the 2026 Masters final round is from 10 a.m. to 12 p.m. ET on Masters.com and Paramount+.
Featured Groups coverage for the 2026 Masters final round is from 10:15 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
Featured Holes (Amen Corner) coverage for the 2026 Masters final round is from 11:45 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
Featured Holes (4, 5 & 6) coverage for the 2026 Masters final round is from 10:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. ET on Masters.com.
Featured Holes (15 & 16) coverage for the 2026 Masters final round is from 12:30 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. ET on Masters.com and Paramount+.
Early Coverage for the 2026 Masters final round is from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
TV Coverage for the 2026 Masters final round is from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on CBS and Paramount+.
Green Jacket Ceremony for the 2026 Masters final round is at 7 p.m. ET on Masters.com.
Streaming of the 2026 Masters final round coverage is available on the Masters App.
